title: The Sleeping Queen
text: A queen lies on a stone bier in the barrow's heart, not rotted at all, her skin like milk, her lips red. Her crown is the finest thing you have ever seen. Her chest does not rise. Her eyes, under the lids, move.

options.label: Take the crown from her head.

outcomes.text: She sleeps on. Her eyes move faster under the lids.

options.label: The bravest kisses her brow, as the old stories say.

outcomes.text: She smiles in her sleep and whispers a name.
You close the door softly. Her dream slips out with you, and the Leader sleeps it that night: a queen's sleep, deep and whole.
